front: O presente trabalho tem como objetivo analisar os impactos da urbanização acelerada.
pronunciation: oo preh-ZEHN-chee trah-BAH-lyoo teng KOH-moo oh-bee-zheh-CHEE-voo ah-nah-lee-ZAHR ooz eem-PAHK-tooz dah oor-bah-nee-zah-SOWNG ah-seh-leh-RAH-dah.
back: This paper aims to analyze the impacts of rapid urbanization.
context: 'O presente trabalho' = this paper/study. 'Ter como objetivo' + infinitive is the standard way to state the aim of academic work.

front: Parte-se da hipótese de que a desigualdade regional afeta o desempenho escolar.
pronunciation: PAHR-chee-see dah ee-POH-teh-zee jee keh ah jee-zee-gwahl-DAH-jee rreh-zhee-oh-NOW ah-FEH-tah oo deh-zehm-PEH-nyoo ehs-koh-LAHR.
back: The starting hypothesis is that regional inequality affects school performance.
context: 'Parte-se de' = we start from (impersonal 'se', typical of academic Portuguese, which avoids 'eu').

front: Para tanto, adotou-se uma abordagem qualitativa baseada em entrevistas.
pronunciation: PAH-rah TAHN-too, ah-doh-TOH-see OO-mah ah-bohr-DAH-zheng kwah-lee-tah-CHEE-vah bah-zee-AH-dah eng ehn-treh-VEES-tahs.
back: To this end, a qualitative approach based on interviews was adopted.
context: 'Para tanto' = to this end. 'Adotou-se' = synthetic passive, the impersonal voice of methodology sections.

front: Cabe ressaltar que os resultados não podem ser generalizados.
pronunciation: KAH-bee rreh-sahl-TAHR keh ooz rreh-zool-TAH-dooz NOWNG POH-deng SEHR zheh-neh-rah-lee-ZAH-dooz.
back: It should be emphasized that the results cannot be generalized.
context: 'Cabe ressaltar/destacar/salientar que' = it is worth emphasizing that. Very frequent in academic texts.

front: Nesse sentido, os dados corroboram a teoria proposta por Freire.
pronunciation: NEH-see sehn-CHEE-doo, ooz DAH-dooz koh-rroh-BOH-rowng ah teh-oh-REE-ah proh-POHS-tah pohr FRAY-ree.
back: In this sense, the data corroborate the theory proposed by Freire.
context: 'Nesse sentido' links ideas. 'Corroborar' = to support/confirm. Paulo Freire is Brazil's most cited educational theorist.

front: Em contrapartida, estudos recentes apontam conclusões divergentes.
pronunciation: eng kohn-trah-pahr-CHEE-dah, ehs-TOO-dooz rreh-SEHN-cheez ah-POHN-towng kohn-kloo-ZOYNGZ jee-vehr-ZHEHN-chees.
back: On the other hand, recent studies point to diverging conclusions.
context: 'Em contrapartida' = on the other hand / in contrast. 'Apontar' = to point to/indicate.

front: Conforme apontado anteriormente, a amostra apresenta limitações.
pronunciation: kohn-FOHR-mee ah-pohn-TAH-doo ahn-teh-ryohr-MEHN-chee, ah ah-MOHS-trah ah-preh-ZEHN-tah lee-mee-tah-SOYNGS.
back: As previously pointed out, the sample has limitations.
context: 'Conforme' = as/according to. 'Anteriormente' refers back to an earlier section.

front: Dessa forma, conclui-se que a hipótese inicial foi confirmada.
pronunciation: DEH-sah FOHR-mah, kohn-KLOO-ee-see keh ah ee-POH-teh-zee ee-nee-SYOW FOY kohn-feer-MAH-dah.
back: Thus, it can be concluded that the initial hypothesis was confirmed.
context: 'Dessa forma' / 'desse modo' = thus. 'Conclui-se que' = it is concluded that.

front: Não obstante as dificuldades, o projeto atingiu suas metas.
pronunciation: NOWNG ohbs-TAHN-chee ahz jee-fee-kool-DAH-jees, oo proh-ZHEH-too ah-cheen-ZHEE-oo SOO-ahz MEH-tahs.
back: Notwithstanding the difficulties, the project achieved its goals.
context: 'Não obstante' = notwithstanding/despite. Very formal, used as a preposition or connector.

front: Tendo em vista o exposto, propõem-se três medidas.
pronunciation: TEHN-doo eng VEES-tah oo ehs-POHS-too, proh-POH-eng-see TREHS meh-JEE-dahs.
back: In light of the above, three measures are proposed.
context: 'Tendo em vista' = in light of. 'O exposto' = what has been set out. 'Propõem-se' agrees with 'três medidas'.

front: Vale salientar que a pesquisa foi aprovada pelo comitê de ética.
pronunciation: VAH-lee sah-lyehn-TAHR keh ah pehs-KEE-zah FOY ah-proh-VAH-dah PEH-loo koh-mee-TEH jee EH-chee-kah.
back: It is worth noting that the research was approved by the ethics committee.
context: 'Vale salientar' = it's worth noting. Ethics approval must be mentioned in Brazilian theses.

front: A fundamentação teórica baseia-se nos trabalhos de Milton Santos.
pronunciation: ah foon-dah-mehn-tah-SOWNG teh-OH-ree-kah bah-ZAY-ah-see nooz trah-BAH-lyooz jee MEEL-tong SAHN-toos.
back: The theoretical framework is based on the work of Milton Santos.
context: 'Fundamentação teórica' = theoretical framework (a standard chapter of a Brazilian thesis). Milton Santos was a leading Brazilian geographer.

front: Segundo Candido (1975), a literatura cumpre uma função humanizadora.
pronunciation: seh-GOON-doo KAHN-jee-doo (MEEL noh-veh-SEHN-tooz ee seh-TEHN-tah ee SEEN-koo), ah lee-teh-rah-TOO-rah KOOM-pree OO-mah foon-SOWNG oo-mah-nee-zah-DOH-rah.
back: According to Candido (1975), literature fulfills a humanizing function.
context: Author-date citation (ABNT style). 'Segundo' = according to. Antonio Candido was a major Brazilian literary critic.

front: Os resultados obtidos sugerem uma correlação positiva entre as variáveis.
pronunciation: ooz rreh-zool-TAH-dooz ohb-CHEE-dooz soo-ZHEH-reng OO-mah koh-rreh-lah-SOWNG poh-zee-CHEE-vah EHN-tree ahz vah-ree-AH-vays.
back: The results obtained suggest a positive correlation between the variables.
context: Academic hedging: 'sugerem' (suggest) instead of 'provam' (prove).

front: Ressalte-se, contudo, que a correlação não implica causalidade.
pronunciation: rreh-SAHL-chee-see, kohn-TOO-doo, keh ah koh-rreh-lah-SOWNG NOWNG eem-PLEE-kah kow-zah-lee-DAH-jee.
back: It should be stressed, however, that correlation does not imply causation.
context: 'Ressalte-se' = let it be stressed (formal jussive subjunctive + 'se'). 'Contudo' = however, often placed between commas.

front: O texto está bem escrito, mas carece de coesão entre os parágrafos.
pronunciation: oo TEHS-too ehs-TAH BENG ehs-KREE-too, mahs kah-REH-see jee koh-eh-ZOWNG EHN-tree ooz pah-RAH-grah-foos.
back: The text is well written, but it lacks cohesion between paragraphs.
context: 'Carecer de' = to lack. 'Coesão' (cohesion) and 'coerência' (coherence) are graded separately in Brazilian essay exams.

front: Evite repetições: em vez de 'mas' o tempo todo, alterne com 'porém', 'contudo' e 'todavia'.
pronunciation: eh-VEE-chee rreh-peh-chee-SOYNGS: eng VEHZ jee MAHYS oo TEHM-poo TOH-doo, ahl-TEHR-nee kohng poh-RENG, kohn-TOO-doo ee toh-dah-VEE-ah.
back: Avoid repetition: instead of 'mas' all the time, alternate with 'porém', 'contudo' and 'todavia'.
context: Four ways to say 'but/however'. 'Porém', 'contudo' and 'todavia' are more formal and can move inside the sentence.

front: A tese central do ensaio é que a tecnologia aprofunda as desigualdades.
pronunciation: ah TEH-zee sehn-TRAHL doo ehn-SAHY-oo EH keh ah tehk-noh-loh-ZHEE-ah ah-proh-FOON-dah ahz jee-zee-gwahl-DAH-jees.
back: The essay's central thesis is that technology deepens inequality.
context: 'Tese' = thesis (both the main argument and a doctoral dissertation). 'Aprofundar' = to deepen.

front: Na redação do Enem, a proposta de intervenção precisa respeitar os direitos humanos.
pronunciation: nah rreh-dah-SOWNG doo eh-NENG, ah proh-POHS-tah jee een-tehr-vehn-SOWNG preh-SEE-zah rrehs-pay-TAHR ooz jee-RAY-tooz oo-MAH-noos.
back: In the Enem essay, the intervention proposal must respect human rights.
context: Enem is Brazil's national university entrance exam. Its argumentative essay must end with a concrete 'proposta de intervenção'.

front: A banca examinadora fez questionamentos sobre a metodologia.
pronunciation: ah BAHN-kah eh-zah-mee-nah-DOH-rah FEHS kehs-chee-oh-nah-MEHN-tooz SOH-bree ah meh-toh-doh-loh-ZHEE-ah.
back: The examining committee raised questions about the methodology.
context: 'Banca (examinadora)' = thesis committee. 'Defender a dissertação' = to defend one's master's thesis.

front: Defendi minha dissertação de mestrado e fui aprovada com louvor.
pronunciation: deh-fehn-JEE MEE-nyah jee-sehr-tah-SOWNG jee mehs-TRAH-doo ee FOO-ee ah-proh-VAH-dah kohng loh-VOHR.
back: I defended my master's thesis and passed with honors.
context: In Brazil, 'dissertação' = master's thesis; 'tese' = doctoral dissertation; 'TCC' = undergraduate final paper.

front: Bom dia a todos. Agradeço a presença e o convite para estar aqui.
pronunciation: BOHNG JEE-ah ah TOH-doos. ah-grah-DEH-soo ah preh-ZEHN-sah ee oo kohn-VEE-chee PAH-rah ehs-TAHR ah-KEE.
back: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for coming and for the invitation to be here.
context: Classic opening of a talk in Brazil: greet, then thank the audience and the hosts.

front: Minha apresentação está dividida em três partes.
pronunciation: MEE-nyah ah-preh-zehn-tah-SOWNG ehs-TAH jee-vee-JEE-dah eng TREHS PAHR-chees.
back: My presentation is divided into three parts.
context: Signposting the structure up front helps the audience follow you.

front: Passando agora ao segundo ponto, vejamos os dados de 2023.
pronunciation: pah-SAHN-doo ah-GOH-rah ah-oo seh-GOON-doo POHN-too, veh-ZHAH-mooz ooz DAH-dooz jee DOYZ MEEL ee VEEN-chee ee TREHS.
back: Moving on now to the second point, let's look at the 2023 data.
context: Transition phrase. 'Vejamos' (let's see) is the first-person plural subjunctive used as an imperative.

front: Como podemos observar neste gráfico, a curva se estabiliza a partir de março.
pronunciation: KOH-moo poh-DEH-mooz ohb-sehr-VAHR NEHS-chee GRAH-fee-koo, ah KOOR-vah see ehs-tah-bee-LEE-zah ah pahr-CHEER jee MAHR-soo.
back: As we can see in this chart, the curve levels off from March onwards.
context: Standard phrase for describing a slide. 'A partir de' = from … onwards.

front: Abro agora para perguntas.
pronunciation: AH-broo ah-GOH-rah PAH-rah pehr-GOON-tahs.
back: I'll now open the floor to questions.
context: Short formula to start the Q&A. Also: 'Fico à disposição para perguntas'.

front: Excelente pergunta. Permita-me responder em duas partes.
pronunciation: eh-seh-LEHN-chee pehr-GOON-tah. pehr-MEE-tah-mee rrehs-pohn-DEHR eng DOO-ahs PAHR-chees.
back: Excellent question. Allow me to answer in two parts.
context: Buys time and structures a complex answer. 'Permita-me' = formal imperative with an enclitic pronoun.

front: Infelizmente, isso foge ao escopo deste estudo.
pronunciation: een-feh-leez-MEHN-chee, EE-soo FOH-zhee ah-oo ehs-KOH-poo DEHS-chee ehs-TOO-doo.
back: Unfortunately, that falls outside the scope of this study.
context: 'Fugir ao escopo' = to fall outside the scope. A polite way to deflect off-topic questions.

front: Para concluir, retomo a pergunta que fiz no início.
pronunciation: PAH-rah kohn-kloo-EER, rreh-TOH-moo ah pehr-GOON-tah keh FEES noo ee-NEE-syoo.
back: To conclude, I return to the question I asked at the beginning.
context: 'Retomar' = to return to / pick up again. Closing the circle makes a talk memorable.

front: Agradeço a atenção de todos e fico à disposição.
pronunciation: ah-grah-DEH-soo ah ah-tehn-SOWNG jee TOH-dooz ee FEE-koo AH jees-poh-zee-SOWNG.
back: Thank you all for your attention; I'm at your disposal.
context: Standard closing. 'Fico à disposição' (with crase) = I'm available for anything you need.

front: Evite ler os slides; use-os como apoio, não como roteiro.
pronunciation: eh-VEE-chee LEHR ooz SLAHY-jees; OO-zee-oos KOH-moo ah-POY-oo, NOWNG KOH-moo rroh-TAY-roo.
back: Avoid reading the slides; use them as support, not as a script.
context: 'Use-os' = use them (enclitic). 'Roteiro' = script/outline.

front: É mister reconhecer as contribuições dos movimentos sociais.
pronunciation: EH mees-TEHR rreh-koh-nyeh-SEHR ahs kohn-tree-boo-ee-SOYNGZ dooz moh-vee-MEHN-toos soh-SYAHYS.
back: It is essential to acknowledge the contributions of social movements.
context: 'É mister' = it is necessary/essential. Very formal, found in speeches and legal or academic writing.

front: À guisa de conclusão, apresento algumas considerações finais.
pronunciation: AH GEE-zah jee kohn-kloo-ZOWNG, ah-preh-ZEHN-too ahl-GOO-mahs kohn-see-deh-rah-SOYNGS fee-NAHYS.
back: By way of conclusion, I present some final remarks.
context: 'À guisa de' = by way of. Brazilian theses usually call the conclusion 'Considerações finais'.

front: O autor incorre em uma contradição ao afirmar que…
pronunciation: oo ow-TOHR een-KOH-rree eng OO-mah kohn-trah-jee-SOWNG ah-oo ah-feer-MAHR keh…
back: The author falls into a contradiction when he claims that…
context: 'Incorrer em' = to fall into (an error, a contradiction). 'Ao' + infinitive = when doing something.

front: Trata-se de um tema amplamente discutido na literatura.
pronunciation: TRAH-tah-see jee oong TEH-mah ahm-plah-MEHN-chee jees-koo-CHEE-doo nah lee-teh-rah-TOO-rah.
back: It is a topic widely discussed in the literature.
context: 'A literatura' here means the academic literature on a subject. 'Trata-se de' never takes a plural verb.

front: Os achados desta pesquisa abrem caminho para estudos futuros.
pronunciation: ooz ah-SHAH-dooz DEHS-tah pehs-KEE-zah AH-breng kah-MEE-nyoo PAH-rah ehs-TOO-dooz foo-TOO-roos.
back: The findings of this research pave the way for future studies.
context: 'Achados' = findings. 'Abrir caminho para' = to pave the way for.

front: Ademais, cumpre destacar o papel das políticas públicas.
pronunciation: ah-jee-MAHYS, KOOM-pree dehs-tah-KAHR oo pah-PEH-oo dahs poh-LEE-chee-kahs POO-blee-kahs.
back: Furthermore, the role of public policy should be highlighted.
context: 'Ademais' = furthermore (formal). 'Cumpre' + infinitive = it is necessary to.

front: Diante disso, faz-se necessária uma revisão do modelo.
pronunciation: jee-AHN-chee JEE-soo, FAHS-see neh-seh-SAH-ryah OO-mah rreh-vee-ZOWNG doo moh-DEH-loo.
back: Given this, a revision of the model is necessary.
context: 'Diante disso' = given this. 'Faz-se necessária' agrees with 'revisão' (feminine).

front: O artigo foi submetido a uma revista com avaliação por pares.
pronunciation: oo ahr-CHEE-goo FOY soob-meh-CHEE-doo ah OO-mah rreh-VEES-tah kohng ah-vah-lyah-SOWNG pohr PAH-rees.
back: The article was submitted to a peer-reviewed journal.
context: 'Revista' = journal (also magazine). 'Avaliação por pares' = peer review.

front: As referências devem seguir as normas da ABNT.
pronunciation: ahs rreh-feh-REHN-syahz DEH-veng seh-GEER ahz NOHR-mahz dah ah-beh-eh-neh-TEH.
back: References must follow ABNT standards.
context: ABNT is the Brazilian standards body; its citation rules are mandatory in most Brazilian universities.

front: O resumo deve conter entre 150 e 250 palavras, seguido de palavras-chave.
pronunciation: oo rreh-ZOO-moo DEH-vee kohn-TEHR EHN-tree SENG-too ee SEEN-kwehn-tah ee doo-ZEHN-tahs ee seen-KWEHN-tah pah-LAH-vrahs, seh-GEE-doo jee pah-LAH-vrahs-SHAH-vee.
back: The abstract must contain between 150 and 250 words, followed by keywords.
context: 'Resumo' = abstract (also summary). 'Palavras-chave' = keywords.

front: Plágio é crime e pode resultar no cancelamento do título.
pronunciation: PLAH-zhyoo EH KREE-mee ee POH-jee rreh-zool-TAHR noo kahn-seh-lah-MEHN-too doo CHEE-too-loo.
back: Plagiarism is a crime and can result in the revocation of the degree.
context: 'Título' here = academic degree/title. In Brazil, plagiarism can be prosecuted as copyright infringement.

front: Gostaria de agradecer, em especial, à minha orientadora.
pronunciation: gohs-tah-REE-ah jee ah-grah-deh-SEHR, eng ehs-peh-SYOW, AH MEE-nyah oh-ryehn-tah-DOH-rah.
back: I would especially like to thank my advisor.
context: 'Orientador(a)' = thesis advisor. 'Agradecer a alguém' takes 'a', hence the crase: 'à minha orientadora'.

front: Em síntese, os argumentos apresentados sustentam a tese defendida.
pronunciation: eng SEEN-teh-zee, ooz ahr-goo-MEHN-tooz ah-preh-zehn-TAH-doos soos-TEHN-towng ah TEH-zee deh-fehn-JEE-dah.
back: In summary, the arguments presented support the thesis defended.
context: 'Em síntese' = in summary. A neat closing sentence for an argumentative essay.

front: Peço licença para discordar do colega que me antecedeu.
pronunciation: PEH-soo lee-SEHN-sah PAH-rah jees-kohr-DAHR doo koh-LEH-gah keh mee ahn-teh-seh-DEH-oo.
back: With your permission, I'd like to disagree with the colleague who spoke before me.
context: Very formal and courteous opening for a disagreement in a panel. 'Anteceder' = to precede.
